resources.string: Draw special characters on the letters instead of gesture typing
Swiping across the letters draws a symbol; gesture typing is off. Taps, long presses and the space and delete swipes stay as they are.

Draw on the letter keys. Strokes that follow within half a second belong to the same symbol (≠, ÷, €). The symbol is typed after the pause; the strip offers up to three alternatives. A quick tap in that half second types the symbol and then the letter; it only counts as a dot where a symbol needs one (÷). Not in password fields.
Recognized locally on the phone. Nothing is sent, drawings are not saved.
Draw a symbol three times and choose the text it types (up to 8 characters, emoji too). Own symbols are recognized together with the built-in ones.
Draw the symbol in the box, with up to 12 strokes.
At most 12 strokes. Please draw it again.
Drawn for too long. Please draw it again.
